_comment: Hand-written text: property names, GUI labels, notifications, advancements, config translations, keybinds. Item/block/medicine display names come from herbs.json / medicines.json / items.json.

STIMULANT.name: Stimulant
STIMULANT.hint: Wakes the body and drives it on.

SEDATIVE.name: Sedative
SEDATIVE.hint: Calms the body and the mind.

TOXIC.name: Toxic
TOXIC.hint: Poisonous in quantity. Handle with care.

FIRE_PROTECTION.name: Fire Ward
FIRE_PROTECTION.hint: Turns environmental heat away from the wearer.

COLD_PROTECTION.name: Cold Ward
COLD_PROTECTION.hint: Holds back the cold of snow and long nights.

HYDRATION.name: Hydration
HYDRATION.hint: Replaces the water a body loses.

ENERGY.name: Energy
ENERGY.hint: Sustains effort and staves off exhaustion.

RESPIRATORY.name: Respiratory
RESPIRATORY.hint: Eases breathing and clears the chest.

REGENERATION.name: Regeneration
REGENERATION.hint: Encourages the body to rebuild itself.
